**Position:** Postdoctoral Researcher at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz

I am a postdoctoral researcher in International Political Economy at the Institute for Political Science at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz. My research and teaching focuses on the digitalization and financialization of the global economy with a particular focus on the role of digital start-up companies.


## Publications

Dutta, Sahil Jai, Ruben Kremers, Fabian Pape, Johannes Petry. (2020). [Critical Macro-Finance: An Introduction](https://doi.org/10.2218/finsoc.v6i1.4407). *Finance and Society*, 6(1): 34--44.

Kremers, Ruben, James Brassett. (2017). [Mobile Payments, Social Money: Everyday Politics of the Consumer Subject](https://doi.org/10.1080/13563467.2017.1306503). *New Political Economy*, 22(6): 645--660.

Kremers, Ruben, Lena Rethel. (2024). [Curated Power: The Performative Politics of (Industry) Events](https://doi.org/10.1093/ips/olad021). *International Political Sociology*, 18(1): olad021.
